# Agent surface audit

<!-- Generated by scripts/agent-surface/audit.ts. Do not edit by hand; run `pnpm agent-surface:audit`. -->

This page measures what an agent meets when it drives GOAT today: the tools mounted on `/mcp` and the `goat` command tree. Every count and cited file comes from loading those registries from source (`scripts/agent-surface/inventory.ts`), so regenerating after a change shows whether a finding still holds. It is the evidence base for the agent surface redesign: it describes problems and ranks fixes, and leaves the target design to that spec.

Run `node scripts/agent-surface/inventory.ts` for the full JSON inventory, including per-tool schemas, hints, enforced access, and the rendered `--help` of every command.

## Naming

Shipped toolkit names follow three shapes. The canonical listed name is derived from the registry path, so these counts measure compatibility names:

| Shape                | Count | Examples                                                                                                                                                                         |
| -------------------- | ----- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `resource_verb`      | 33    | `channel_bot_home`, `channel_bot_home_claim`, `channel_ingest`, `channel_input_get`, `channel_task_export`, `channel_task_get`, and 27 more                                      |
| `verb_resource`      | 38    | `create_threads`, `delegate_task`, `delete_scheduled_task`, `link_pull_request`, `list_scheduled_tasks`, `list_thread_pull_requests`, and 32 more                                |
| `goat_resource_verb` | 208   | `goat_acp_session_list`, `goat_attachment_discard`, `goat_attachment_pending_list`, `goat_attachment_prepare_upload`, `goat_background_wait`, `goat_cloud_holders`, and 202 more |

The `goat_` prefix marks only some tools, and the catalog test pins exactly that set (apps/server/src/mcp/toolkits/core.test.ts `publishes unique tool names`). `create_threads`, `delegate_task`, `delete_scheduled_task`, `link_pull_request`, `list_scheduled_tasks`, `list_thread_pull_requests`, `preview_back`, `preview_click`, and 30 more put the verb first, and `channel_bot_home`, `channel_bot_home_claim`, `channel_ingest`, `channel_input_get`, `channel_task_export`, `channel_task_get`, `channel_task_list`, `channel_task_move`, and 25 more put an unprefixed resource first. Pull requests use `link_pull_request` and `watch_pull_request` where threads use `goat_thread_watch`; scheduled tasks are `schedule_task`, `list_scheduled_tasks`, and `run_scheduled_task_now`.

## Schemas and envelopes

- **Undeclared arguments.** Every published input schema closes its top level, and every registration refuses undeclared arguments at call time (apps/server/src/mcp/McpHttpServer.ts `applyToolContracts`).
- **Two failure modes.** Tools split 238 `return` and 41 `error`. Both reach the client as `isError` with JSON in a text block and no `structuredContent` (apps/server/src/mcp/toolkits/core.test.ts `declaredFailure`), so an agent parses text to branch on an error.
- **7 error families.** 212 tools fail with `OrchestratorMcpFailure`; 4 tools fail with 8 tagged errors; 3 tools fail with `OperationError`; 30 tools fail with 20 tagged errors; 27 tools fail with 21 tagged errors; 1 tools fail with `OrchestratorMcpFailure` or `SshThreadHandoffFailure`; 2 tools fail with `OrchestratorMcpFailure` or `WorktreeMcpFailure`. Only `OrchestratorMcpFailure` carries a machine `code` (packages/contracts/src/orchestratorMcpFailure.ts `OrchestratorMcpFailureCode`). Preview, device, worktree, and pull request failures are told apart by `_tag` alone, and every preview tool advertises all of its toolkit's tags whether or not it can raise them.
- **Idempotency.** 76 tools accept `clientRequestId`: `channel_bot_home_claim`, `channel_ingest`, `create_threads`, `delegate_task`, `device_open`, `goat_attachment_prepare_upload`, `goat_cloud_launch`, `goat_cloud_machine_create`, `goat_decision_request`, `goat_eval`, and 66 more. The other 99 mutating tools have no retry key, including the destructive `delete_scheduled_task`, `device_close`, `goat_attachment_discard`, `goat_call`, `goat_cloud_run_forget`, `goat_connection_remove`, `goat_decision_answer`, `goat_environment_preferences_update`, `goat_environment_settings_update`, `goat_fallback_chain_set`, and 29 more.
- **Pagination.** 16 tools use `cursor/nextCursor` (`channel_task_export`, `channel_task_list`, `goat_acp_session_list`, `goat_cloud_run_list`, and 12 more); 15 tools use `limit only` (`goat_decision_list`, `goat_describe`, `goat_docs_read`, `goat_docs_search`, and 11 more); 1 tool uses `afterSequence/hasMore` (`goat_origin_reports_wait`); 1 tool uses `limit/hasMore` (`goat_thread_read`). List tools with no page control: `device_list`, `goat_attachment_pending_list`, `goat_cloud_machine_list`, `goat_connection_list`, `goat_host_link_list`, `goat_note_list`, `goat_pending_request_list`, `goat_provider_addable_list`, `goat_ssh_host_list`, `goat_terminal_list`, `goat_thread_watch_list`, `list_scheduled_tasks`, and 1 more.
- **Hints that disagree with enforcement.** The handler's `McpToolAccess` declaration is what the server enforces; the MCP `readOnlyHint` is what clients see. They disagree for no tools. Reads declared `actsAsCaller` without a read-only hint: `task_status`.
- **Image results.** `device_screenshot`, `goat_screen_run`, `html_preview`, `preview_snapshot` are registered directly to return image content (apps/server/src/mcp/McpHttpServer.ts `imageToolRegistration`).

## Descriptions and examples

Only 46% of input parameters carry a description. 97 tools describe none of their parameters, for example `channel_ingest`, `channel_input_get`, `channel_task_export`, `channel_task_get`, `channel_task_list`, `channel_task_move`, `channel_task_report`, `delete_scheduled_task`, `device_list`, `goat_attachment_discard`, and 87 more. Optional fields encode as `anyOf [T, null]` with no stated default, so an agent learns defaults only from prose.

71 of 279 tools show a worked call, in their description or as examples `goat_describe` serves (63 tools). 160 tools have no `Tool.Title`. Description length is uneven; the longest are:

| Tool                     | Characters | Declared at                                             |
| ------------------------ | ---------- | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| `goat_call`              | 1688       | packages/contracts/src/agentSurface/surfaceEntries.ts   |
| `delegate_task`          | 400        | packages/contracts/src/agentSurface/entries/task.ts     |
| `goat_ssh_thread_launch` | 399        | packages/contracts/src/agentSurface/entries/ssh.ts      |
| `goat_describe`          | 396        | packages/contracts/src/agentSurface/surfaceEntries.ts   |
| `goat_eval`              | 392        | packages/contracts/src/agentSurface/surfaceEntries.ts   |
| `goat_worktree_handoff`  | 390        | packages/contracts/src/agentSurface/entries/worktree.ts |

Long descriptions carry routing policy (when to use another tool, what to tell the user) that every session pays for in context and no test checks.

## Errors an agent cannot act on

- `orchestration_error` is raised across `apps/server/src/mcp`, for example in apps/server/src/mcp/AgentTerminalMcpService.ts, apps/server/src/mcp/AgentWorkspaceMcpService.ts, apps/server/src/mcp/AgentWorkspaceTerminalAudit.ts, apps/server/src/mcp/HostStatusMcpService.ts. The code does not say whether to retry, fix the input, or ask the user.
- `invalid_request` is raised across `apps/server/src/mcp`, for example in apps/server/src/mcp/AgentWorkspaceTerminalAccess.ts, apps/server/src/mcp/HostStatusMcpService.ts, apps/server/src/mcp/HostThreadsMcpService.ts, apps/server/src/mcp/LaunchWatchService.ts. The code does not say whether to retry, fix the input, or ask the user.
- `OrchestratorMcpFailure` has only `code` and `message` (packages/contracts/src/orchestratorMcpFailure.ts `OrchestratorMcpFailure`): no retry hint, offending field, or next action. Recovery advice, where it exists, lives in message text.

## Where a human is required

These are the steps GOAT cannot finish without a person today, and how an agent finds out:

| Step                                          | How it surfaces to an agent                                                                                                                                                       | Evidence                                                                                                         |
| --------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Enter a secret (webhook signing, credentials) | Agent calls `request_secret`; the user types the value in the app; the agent gets a `secretRef`. Only callable from inside a GOAT thread.                                         | packages/contracts/src/agentSurface/entries/handoff.ts, apps/server/src/mcp/completionWebhook.ts                 |
| Answer a provider question or approval        | The thread turns waiting; `goat_pending_request_list`, `goat_pending_request_read`, and `goat_pending_request_respond` let an agent answer, and escalation names the tool to use. | apps/server/src/orchestration-v2/QuestionEscalationService.ts, apps/server/src/mcp/PendingQuestionsMcpService.ts |
| Raise runtime or interaction mode             | The call fails with `runtime_mode_escalation_denied` or `interaction_mode_escalation_denied`. No tool requests approval, so the agent must stop and tell the user.                | packages/contracts/src/orchestratorMcpFailure.ts                                                                 |
| Grant a capability or credential              | The call fails with `capability_denied` or `thread_credential_required`; the user resolves it in settings or by issuing a token.                                                  | packages/contracts/src/orchestratorMcpFailure.ts                                                                 |
| GOAT Connect sign-in (OAuth or device code)   | CLI only: `goat connect login`, or `--headless` for the device flow. No MCP tool starts it or reports its state.                                                                  | (not found)                                                                                                      |
| Pair a client                                 | `goat pair` or `goat auth pairing create` on the host, or Settings → Connections. ## CLI

The operator CLI has 62 listed commands for server operations. Registry commands are dispatched before that tree loads: `goat describe`, `goat call`, and generated `goat <resource> <verb>` commands expose the agent surface. The legacy `goat acp-mcp-call` remains an alias (apps/server/src/cli/acpMcpBridge.ts).

- 0 of 81 commands define usage examples, so `--help` never shows a worked call.
- 11 of 47 listed leaf commands offer `--json`: `goat auth pairing create`, `goat auth pairing list`, `goat auth session issue`, `goat auth session list`, `goat auth client create`, `goat auth client list`, `goat provider diagnose`, `goat thread list`, `goat thread start`, `goat thread send`, `goat thread show`.
- 20 commands have no description, all of them unlisted internals. Undescribed parameters: `goat acp-mcp-call arguments`, `goat call arguments`, `goat describe arguments`, `goat imessage enable --allow`, `goat imessage enable --own`, `goat imessage enable --full-access`, and 52 more.
- `goat auth client revoke` reuses the session revoke command under a second parent, so its help reads "Revoke an active session." (apps/server/src/cli/auth.ts).
- Server flags such as `--dev-url` repeat on subcommands that start no server, such as `goat auth pairing create`.

## Drift between docs and the registry

Scanned the Markdown docs (docs, structure, skills, root guides) and the agent prompt sources in `packages/provider-core/src/server`.

Names that look like tools but are not in the registry:

| Name           | Where                                                                                                          |
| -------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `list_changed` | docs/internals/agent-surface.md                                                                                |
| `run_steps`    | structure/decisions/ADR-0022-cua-driver-computer-use.md, structure/decisions/ADR-0023-goat-computer-use-app.md |
| `run_script`   | structure/decisions/ADR-0022-cua-driver-computer-use.md, structure/decisions/ADR-0023-goat-computer-use-app.md |
| `list_apps`    | structure/decisions/ADR-0022-cua-driver-computer-use.md                                                        |

Every `goat ...` invocation in the docs names a real command and flags it accepts; flag values are not checked.

142 of 279 tools are never named in any Markdown doc, and 138 are named in neither docs nor agent prompts: `channel_bot_home`, `channel_ingest`, `channel_task_export`, `channel_task_list`, `channel_task_move`, `delete_scheduled_task`, `goat_acp_session_list`, `goat_attachment_discard`, `goat_attachment_pending_list`, `goat_attachment_prepare_upload`, `goat_cloud_machine_create`, `goat_cloud_machine_resume`, `goat_cloud_run_list`, `goat_connection_list`, `goat_connection_remove`, `goat_decision_escalate`, `goat_decision_list`, `goat_environment_read`, `goat_environment_usage`, `goat_host_link_create`, `goat_host_link_list`, `goat_host_link_remove`, `goat_host_process_history`, `goat_host_resource_history`, and 114 more. Agents can discover these with `goat_describe`.

Listed CLI commands no doc invokes: `goat auth pairing list`, `goat auth pairing revoke`, `goat project add`, `goat project remove`, `goat project rename`, `goat thread start`, `goat triage`.

The server's `/llms.txt` lists every registry path with its summary. `goat_describe` serves input and output schemas from the registered tools, and examples for 63 of them.

## Fixes ranked by agent impact

1. **One error envelope with a machine code and a next action.** 7 error families and two failure modes (238 `return`, 41 `error`) all arrive as JSON inside text. Return `structuredContent` shaped like `{code, message, retryable, field?, next?}` from every tool so an agent branches on data.
2. **A single human handoff primitive.** Secrets, approvals, mode escalation, capability grants, and sign-in each surface differently (see "Where a human is required"). One handoff result with an id, what the user must do and where, plus one wait call, lets any agent pause and resume instead of failing.
3. **Complete the on-demand tool reference.** 138 tools appear in no doc or prompt. `/llms.txt` lists every path for the calling credential, and `goat_describe` already serves schemas from the registered tools and examples for 63 of them. Add examples to the rest, and related paths, there without committed reference pages (decision D14 in agent-surface.md).
4. **Describe every parameter.** 585 of 1091 parameters have no description, and 97 tools describe none. Extend the catalog test at apps/server/src/mcp/toolkits/agentSurface/discovery.test.ts `describes every argument of the paths goat_call lists`, which fails on an undescribed argument of a path with examples, to every tool.
5. **Retry keys on every mutating tool.** 99 mutating tools take no `clientRequestId`, so a dropped response leaves an agent unable to retry safely. Start with destructive tools and thread launch.
6. **Derive hints from enforcement.** Compute `readOnlyHint` from the handler's `McpToolAccess` declaration instead of annotating it separately. 1 tools disagree or under-declare today, which misleads clients that auto-approve reads.
7. **Ship `goat` on PATH with the app.** Agents outside GOAT need a stable entry point. Put the launcher on PATH by default with a clear opt-out, and make `goat --version` the first-run check.
8. **`--json` on every listed leaf command.** Only 11 of 47 offer it; agents parse human tables otherwise.
9. **Examples in help and tool descriptions, executed in tests.** 0 CLI commands use `Command.withExamples` and 71 tools show a call. Registry examples are data that goat_describe serves and a test decodes against each tool's parameters; render them into CLI help too, and run them in a smoke test.
10. **Uniform pagination.** Use one cursor shape everywhere and add it to list tools that lack one (`device_list`, `goat_attachment_pending_list`, `goat_cloud_machine_list`, `goat_connection_list`, `goat_host_link_list`, `goat_note_list`, `goat_pending_request_list`, `goat_provider_addable_list`, `goat_ssh_host_list`, `goat_terminal_list`, `goat_thread_watch_list`, `list_scheduled_tasks`, `list_thread_pull_requests`).
11. **Move routing policy out of tool descriptions.** The longest description is 1688 characters, mostly when-to-use guidance. Keep descriptions to what the tool does and its contract, and put policy in the orchestration prompt once.
12. **Group tools by resource.** Move queue and pending request tools out of the thread toolkit and thread launch out of the project toolkit, and give scheduled tasks one toolkit, so permissions, docs, and discovery follow the resource an agent is working on.
